=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5932-5933 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: When independent verification fails without reaching the autofix iteration cap, the PR is labeled `ai:review-blocked` but the standard explanatory comment is skipped.
  WHY: The label step includes the verification-failed condition, but the comment step only checks whether the iteration cap was reached.
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py:184 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `_build_wait_view` unconditionally waits on all non-completed checks for every review, including pending, requested, waiting, and null-status checks.
  WHY: Regular reviews can now wait up to `CHECK_RUNS_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECS` (default 300s) for checks that the previous filter ignored.
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py:280 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `_build_context_text` unconditionally classifies non-completed checks and completed checks with null conclusions as incomplete for every review.
  WHY: Regular-review context now includes pending, requested, waiting, and null-conclusion checks, changing the information provided to reviewers beyond the Claude-fixer verification probe.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5930 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The `CLAUDE_FIXER_REVIEW_BLOCKED` log emits `reason=true` when verification fails instead of a descriptive reason.
  WHY: `CLAUDE_FIXER_VERIFICATION_FAILED` is set to the literal string `true`, so log analysis cannot distinguish verification failures from iteration-cap failures using this reason field.
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py:428 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The wait-loop timeout warning says checks are “queued/in_progress” even when it is waiting on other non-completed statuses.
  WHY: The message can mislead operators when a pending or null-status check caused the timeout.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_claude_fixer_handoff.sh:89-126 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The clean-ledger awk validation tightly couples the handoff script to the summariser’s exact empty-ledger placeholder and minimum reviewer-block count.
  WHY: A future summariser output-shape change can silently demote a clean review to a findings hand-off with no findings to address.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:757-760; .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py:257-265 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The workflow gate validates the fixer bot login format, but the check-in checker only compares the login and does not apply the same format validation.
  WHY: The two surfaces can disagree about whether a verdict is valid when the configured login does not conform to the workflow regex.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1955 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `claude-fixer-auto-merge` job uses the magic-string condition `legacy_disabled`, which the gate never sets.
  WHY: The job is always skipped, and a future gate-output change could break the contract without maintainers noticing the dead string.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Bind verdicts to a provenance-checked fixer identity and exact findings ledger, and require an independent automated verification of unresolved findings on the same head before enabling auto-merge."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml gate + scripts/review_autofix_step_claude_fixer_handoff.sh + .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py + scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The four required mechanisms are all present in the diff: (1) bot-login distinctness check at review_autofix.yml:765 and check_in_status.py:264-265, (2) v2 digest binding at handoff script line 178 and the gate's `$digest` extraction, (3) already-verified-unresolved short-circuit at review_autofix.yml:766-771, (4) `claude-fixer-auto-merge` job disabled at review_autofix.yml:1955, and (5) fresh ready check snapshot for zero-findings at handoff script lines 121-137.
- requirement: "Bind verdicts to a provenance-checked fixer identity and exact findings ledger"
  expected_change_site: .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py, scripts/review_autofix_step_claude_fixer_handoff.sh, .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml gate
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: Satisfied. The gate validates `CLAUDE_FIXER_VERDICT_BOT_LOGIN` against `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*\[bot\]$`, verifies the bot's `user.type == "Bot"`, requires a v2 verdict marker bound to the v2 handoff's head, round, and SHA-256 ledger digest, and rejects verdicts from collaborators or the GH_PAT account itself. The check_in_status.py checker mirrors these requirements.
- requirement: "Require an independent automated verification of unresolved findings on the same head before enabling auto-merge"
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml gate, codex-agent reviewer dispatch, "Enable auto-merge on PR" step
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: Satisfied. The gate sets `CLAUDE_FIXER_VERIFY=true` and `SHOULD_RUN=true` on a verified bot verdict, the codex-agent forces `AUTOFIX_RESUME_RESTORED=false AUTOFIX_RESUME_SHOULD_CONTINUE=false REVIEW_REVIEWER_ITERATION_SCOPING=0` for verification runs (line 4344-4346), the `claude-fixer-auto-merge` job is disabled (`if: legacy_disabled`), and the "Enable auto-merge on PR" step requires `CLAUDE_FIXER_ZERO_FINDINGS == 'true'` in Claude-fixer mode.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5932-5933 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The “Post review-blocked comment on PR (autofix exhaustion)” step only fires when `max_iterations_reached == 'true'`, while the label step also fires when verification fails.
  WHY: A verification-failed PR can receive `ai:review-blocked` without the standard explanatory comment.
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py:428 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The wait-loop timeout message says “still queued/in_progress” although `_build_wait_view` waits for all non-completed statuses.
  WHY: The warning is misleading when a pending or null-status check caused the timeout.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5930 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The bash expansion `${CLAUDE_FIXER_VERFICATION_FAILED:-max_autofix_iterations}` emits `reason=true` when verification fails.
  WHY: Log analysis cannot distinguish verification-failure blocks from iteration-cap blocks by parsing this reason field.
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py:178-193; 280 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: `_build_wait_view` and `_build_context_text` apply their broadened status filters unconditionally to all reviews, not only the Claude-fixer verification probe.
  WHY: Regular reviews now wait on pending checks and list them as incomplete, potentially paying the full timeout for stalled checks.
